subject: The 205 challenge, 10 Rounds 1 Lappers
author: SUFFUR
body:
Well I think I came 5th over all, with the rules being anything goes I was raped a lot, but then I took 4 people down at the start of one race, and boosted away for a while, but was timed out twice because I kept crashing anyway, I was not in the zone as it were, and I was not in the Zone last night either, but someone got disconnected yesterday and last night so rank is being spread out, lol.

The night before DM, did 10 rounds default laps, and that was fun, hard work, and all stores, like foods and powder breaks had to be taken well in advance, but it was fun to put all that energy in, I was doing well up to 5 races, but started to lose it as we got near the end, but it does test your metal.

Anyway, one day I will not crsah so much and maybe win one of these events as it were, I think I did ok in one race and came second, which is always good.

And the secret is not to crash, and if it's normal racing the Criterion 205 is heavier than the Revenge Racer so can win the bump takedowns over all, due to it's wieght unless the Revenge Racer hits you at high speed, then it'll just run you over.

But again some great racing form people was a good laugh, Voodoo bag anyone?

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?

subject: DM's room the pain....
author: SUFFUR
body:
So went looking for a rematch yesterday to see if I could sort out my The mess that was my rank, not that 3K is a bad rank, and got in my 205 as I know I could do better than in the Low Rider, and the warm ups with the Black Elite, the 360 car were not going well, nor in the Revenge, but Kev was sat 40K after he came back on, so was evening out the scores so he could be allowed to join some rooms, any way I was not on form, ok but not as good as the previous day but I digress. As I was in Kev's room then.

So being invited in to DM's room, as Kev's rank came down and doing the Revenge thing, and doing the 10 round single lappers, and I ask DM to open up the cars, I pick the 205 and we begin the race, DM is on 460  and every one else is less than 15k, and has a good sampling of racers.

The races start, I'm doing ok, not timing out and on the third or could be the second round Angel Valley and going to be getting a third or forth place, it's that interesting type of race, when on the last corner, through the short cut, where you can hit the fence in middle and i'm flying into the left side of the cut, when I hear a commotion, the first 2/3 have wreaked into the bus and traffic is flying, people are crying, laughing and generally knowing it's gone Pete Tong, FLASH BACK up to you what comes to mind, so I've got a chance to win as I'm flying and clip the damn wall as all the crashing is happen, I scream noooooo.... and disconnect?

Of couse, I'm a bit upset, but decide to use the time to reset my router, powder my nose, get a drink and wash my sweaty racing hands, fire the 360 back up and they are on round 6 of the ten, so I find a room to dump my drop out rank, 3 rounds at 2 laps each, sounds about a good timing, I then jump back into DM's room and I'm 50K?!? ouch, and I'm allowed to stay which is nice, we do another 10 rounder, and people really don't want me to beat them, so the racing is interesting, but I am moving up and down the table of scores, even winning a race but end up 5th I think, but by the end of the loading screen I'm 8k, which means I spead my rank across 11 people over 2 sets of races, and there may have been a drop out in that race too but he was around the 14k mark, I don't know what he ended up with but by then it was later so we went to bed etc. By the way the cars are locked to 209, so Revenging.

I'm not sayin, I should be dumping my rank, but then again I'm not the only person who does this, as it was discussed in the first few days of Revenges release, when disconnects happend more frequently, due to it being new. And rank was important then, lol.

So still waiting to see if the 205 can do well in a 10 round single lapper room, maybe tonight?

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
